subject: object of type ‘builtin’ is not subsettable for ggmap

messages.author: bfa14deee30d89e8
messages.subject: object of type ‘builtin’ is not subsettable for ggmap
parts:
.  I received the following error in the log:  Warning error in $: object of type ‘builtin’ is not subsettable.  The stacktrace (innermost first) has layer listed.  I’m just doing a graph.  The key section I think is:

 

ColumbusMap + stat_density2d( aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, fill = ..level.., alpha = ..level..), size = 2, bins = 14, data=all[all$year==2017,], geom = "polygon" ) + scale_fill_gradient(low="red", high="royalblue") +

+     guides(alpha=FALSE)

 

I also get Warning ‘panel.margin’ is deprecated.  Please use ‘panel.spacing’ property instead.

 

The application works fine on my laptop.


Thanks,


Marie

messages.author: 4317e7b9c140bf2d
messages.subject: Re: object of type ‘builtin’ is not subsettable for ggmap
parts:
The "not subsettable" error typically means you're trying to subset (ie, use $ or []) something that you think is a dataframe or list that is actually a function. For example, in this code, you are subsetting the variable "all". If that's a function, then you need to subset "all()".

Tom
